verdict.rationale: BugSnag documents user-defined rules that automate triage, such as automatically assigning errors from a given directory to a team or collaborator. Dashboard discard rules filter events and are now enforced in mobile SDKs. Integrations also act on incoming error activity: PagerDuty incidents are created on error activity, and the webhook plugin sends a message when events are received. missing for 10: a general-purpose rule engine with configurable conditions and a broader set of actions, documented trigger-condition options for integration notifications, independent or hands-on corroboration of the automation rules.
